70171-north-africa-and-the-desert.title: Scenes And Moods
70171-north-africa-and-the-desert.creator: George E. Woodberry
70171-north-africa-and-the-desert.description: A book by George E. Woodberry. ough was my first acquaintance with the land side, weary, cheerless, desolate, like windy prairies in autumn, uninhabited, uninhabitable; and I was chilled to the bone when I came back to the hotel, then in the bud of its first season. It is more sober now, but then it had a near cousinship to Monte Carlo; it was delightfully irresponsible, vivacious, gay.

arxiv-1801-06689.title: Learning model-based strategies in simple environments with hierarchical q-networks
arxiv-1801-06689.creator: Necati Alp Müyesser, Kyle Dunovan, Timothy Verstynen
arxiv-1801-06689.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Necati Alp Müyesser, Kyle Dunovan, Timothy Verstynen. Recent advances in deep learning have allowed artificial agents to rival human-level performance on a wide range of complex tasks; however, the ability of these networks to learn generalizable strategies remains a pressing challenge. This critical limitation is due in part to two factors: the opaque information representation in deep neural networks and the complexity of the task environments in which they are typically deployed.

arxiv-2102-06545.title: Site-Selective Dynamics of Azidolysozyme
arxiv-2102-06545.creator: Seyedeh Maryam Salehi, Markus Meuwly
arxiv-2102-06545.description: Abstract The spectroscopic response of and structural dynamics around all azido-modified alanine residues (AlaN 3 ) in Lysozyme is characterized. It is found that AlaN 3 is a positionally sensitive probe for the local dynamics, covering a frequency range of ∼ 15 \sim 15 cm -1 for the center frequency of the line shape.

arxiv-2104-00790.title: Molecular Nature of Thermodynamics and its Application to Nanosize Particle Systems
arxiv-2104-00790.creator: Eduardo Hernández-Huerta a , Ruben Santamaria a and Tomás Rocha Rinza b
arxiv-2104-00790.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Eduardo Hernández-Huerta a , Ruben Santamaria a and Tomás Rocha Rinza b. The origins of thermodynamics from the microscopic properties of matter have not been satisfactorily accounted for. This work presents a formulation that connects Lagrangian mechanics to thermodynamics.

arxiv-2212-04576.title: Generalizing LTL Instructions via Future Dependent Options
arxiv-2212-04576.creator: Duo Xu, Faramarz Fekri
arxiv-2212-04576.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Duo Xu, Faramarz Fekri. In many real-world applications of control system and robotics, linear temporal logic (LTL) is a widely-used task specification language which has a compositional grammar that naturally induces temporally extended behaviours across tasks, including conditionals and alternative realizations. An important problem in RL with LTL tasks is to learn task-conditioned policies which can zero-shot generalize to new LTL instructions not observed in the training.

arxiv-2305-09660.title: Osteosarcoma Tumor Detection using Transfer Learning Models Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2305-09660.creator: Raisa Fairooz Meem, Khandaker Tabin Hasan
arxiv-2305-09660.description: Abstract The field of clinical image analysis has been applying transfer learning models increasingly due to their less computational complexity, better accuracy etc. These are pre-trained models that don’t require to be trained from scratch which eliminates the necessity of large datasets.

arxiv-2311-02697.title: SinClave: Hardware-assisted Singletons for TEEs
arxiv-2311-02697.creator: Franz Gregor, Robert Krahn, Do Le Quoc, Christof Fetzer
arxiv-2311-02697.description: Abstract . For trusted execution environments (TEEs), remote attestation permits establishing trust in software executed on a remote host. It requires that the measurement of a remote TEE is both complete and fresh: We need to measure all aspects that might determine the behavior of an application, and this measurement has to be reasonably fresh.

arxiv-2407-16993.title: LoFormer: Local Frequency Transformer for Image Deblurring
arxiv-2407-16993.creator: Xintian Mao, Jiansheng Wang, Xingran Xie, Qingli Li, Yan Wang
arxiv-2407-16993.description: Abstract . Due to the computational complexity of self-attention (SA), prevalent techniques for image deblurring often resort to either adopting localized SA or employing coarse-grained global SA methods, both of which exhibit drawbacks such as compromising global modeling or lacking fine-grained correlation.

arxiv-2501-06429.title: Reliable Imputed-Sample Assisted Vertical Federated Learning
arxiv-2501-06429.creator: Yaopei Zeng, Li Liu, Lei Liu, Shaoguo Liu, Hongjian Dou, Yaopei Zeng 1 , Lei Liu 2 , Shaoguo Liu 3 , Hongjian Dou 3 , Baoyuan Wu 2 , Li Liu 4,∗
arxiv-2501-06429.description: Abstract Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) is a well-known FL variant that enables multiple parties to collaboratively train a model without sharing their raw data. Existing VFL approaches focus on overlapping samples among different parties, while their performance is constrained by the limited number of these samples, leaving numerous non-overlapping samples unexplored.

arxiv-2505-24274.title: MGS3: A Multi-Granularity Self-Supervised Code Search Framework
arxiv-2505-24274.creator: Rui Li, Junfeng Kang, Qi Liu, Liyang He, Zheng Zhang, Yunhao Sha, Linbo Zhu, Zhenya Huang
arxiv-2505-24274.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rui Li, Junfeng Kang, Qi Liu, Liyang He, Zheng Zhang, Yunhao Sha, Linbo Zhu, Zhenya Huang. In the pursuit of enhancing software reusability and developer productivity, code search has emerged as a key area, aimed at retrieving code snippets relevant to functionalities based on natural language queries. Despite significant progress in self-supervised code pre-training utilizing the vast amount of code data in repositories, existing methods have primarily focused on leveraging contrastive learning to align natural language with function-level code snippets.

pmc-10637373.title: Analysis of the heavy metal contents’ effect on steroidal saponins and the anti-breast cancer activity of Paris polyphylla var. yunnanensis
pmc-10637373.creator: Hai-Ling Li, Cui-Ping Yan, Jun-Sheng Qi, Shuo Zhang, Dong-Qin Guo, Wen-Chao Gu, Ying-Mei Wu, Yu Wu, Nong Zhou
pmc-10637373.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). yunnanensis, as a near-threatened and ethnic medicine in China, used to be a key ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine in treatment of traumatic injuries, sore throat, snakebites, and convulsions for thousands of years. However, there were no reports on the inverse relationship between the contents of heavy metals and saponins and its anti-breast cancer pharmacological activity in P.

pmc-10696949.title: One-pot synthesis of Ag–In–Ga–S nanocrystals embedded in a Ga2O3 matrix and enhancement of band-edge emission by Na+ doping†
pmc-10696949.creator: Makoto Tozawa, Chie Miyamae, Kazutaka Akiyoshi, Tatsuya Kameyama, Takahisa Yamamoto, Genichi Motomura, Yoshihide Fujisaki, Taro Uematsu, Susumu Kuwabata, Tsukasa Torimoto
pmc-10696949.description: I–III–VI-based semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) have been intensively explored because of their unique controllable optoelectronic properties. Here we report one-pot synthesis of Na-doped Ag–In–Ga–S (AIGS) QDs incorporated in a Ga2O3 matrix. The obtained QDs showed a sharp band-edge photoluminescence peak at 557 nm without a broad-defect site emission.

pmc-11417383.title: Structural basis of Cas3 activation in type I-C CRISPR-Cas system
pmc-11417383.creator: Do Yeon Kim, So Yeon Lee, Hyun Ji Ha, Hyun Ho Park
pmc-11417383.description: CRISPR-Cas systems function as adaptive immune mechanisms in bacteria and archaea and offer protection against phages and other mobile genetic elements. Among many types of CRISPR-Cas systems, Type I CRISPR-Cas systems are most abundant, with target interference depending on a multi-subunit, RNA-guided complex known as Cascade that recruits a transacting helicase nuclease, Cas3, to degrade the target.

pmc-11433587.title: Integrating Machine Learning with Multi-Omics Technologies in Geroscience: Towards Personalized Medicine
pmc-11433587.creator: Nikolaos Theodorakis, Georgios Feretzakis, Lazaros Tzelves, Evgenia Paxinou, Christos Hitas, Georgia Vamvakou, Vassilios S. Verykios, Maria Nikolaou
pmc-11433587.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Aging is a fundamental biological process characterized by a progressive decline in physiological functions and an increased susceptibility to diseases. Understanding aging at the molecular level is crucial for developing interventions that could delay or reverse its effects. This review explores the integration of machine learning (ML) with multi-omics technologies—including genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics, and metabolomics—in studying the molecular hallmarks of aging to develop personalized medicine interventions.

pmc-11672515.title: Investigation of Ki-67 and Clinical Outcome in Feline Nasal Adenocarcinoma Treated Using Hypofractionated Radiotherapy
pmc-11672515.creator: Premkamon Aonta, Piraya Jaiyangyeun, Wutthiwong Theerapan, Supreeya Srisampan, Charuwan Wongsali, Attawit Kovitvadhi, Tassanee Jaroensong
pmc-11672515.description: Simple SummaryNasal adenocarcinoma is the second most common nasal tumor in cats, and radiotherapy (RT) is a common treatment. Ki-67, a prognostic marker in human cancers treated using RT, was investigated in this retrospective study of 19 cats with nasal adenocarcinoma that had been treated using hypofractionated RT.

pmc-11684077.title: SnRK1α1-mediated RBOH1 phosphorylation regulates reactive oxygen species to enhance tolerance to low nitrogen in tomato
pmc-11684077.creator: Xuelian Zheng, Hongfei Yang, Jinping Zou, Weiduo Jin, Zhenyu Qi, Ping Yang, Jingquan Yu, Jie Zhou
pmc-11684077.description: Nitrogen is essential for plant growth and development. SNF1-related protein kinase 1 (SnRK1) is an evolutionarily conserved protein kinase pivotal for regulating plant responses to nutrient deficiency. Here, we discovered that the expression and activity of the SnRK1 α-catalytic subunit (SnRK1α1) increased in response to low-nitrogen stress.

pmc-12989641.title: Physiological Processing of Everyday Aversive Mental Imagery
pmc-12989641.creator: Xuan Yang, Sewon Oh, Jacob Stanley, Sarah Hammons, Ashley Anderson, Esha Gandhi, Douglas H. Wedell, Svetlana V. Shinkareva
pmc-12989641.description: Everyday aversive experiences, such as a crying infant or the sound of construction, are not life‐threatening, yet they can strongly shape affective experience and physiological state. While most affective imagery research has focused on fear and anxiety, the mechanisms underlying imagery of mild, everyday aversive events remain underexplored.

pmc-13039536.title: Cetuximab co-treatment with KRAS G12C inhibitors fulzerasib and sotorasib in human KRAS G12C non-small cell lung cancer cells
pmc-13039536.creator: Daniel Olmo-González, Mengxin Zhou, Nuno G Oliveira, Fusheng Zhou, Feng Yan, Jèssica González, Kevin València-Clua, Miguel Angel Molina-Vila, Jordi Bertrán-Alamillo, Ana Giménez-Capitán, Jordi Codony-Servat, Rafael Rosell
pmc-13039536.description: Resistance to KRAS G12C inhibitors is a major cause of poor prognosis in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Sotorasib and fulzerasib target the KRAS protein in the guanosine diphosphate (GDP)-bound inactive state. Used in monotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients, these drugs yielded response rates of 41% and 49% and median progression-free survival of 6.3 and 9.

pmc-13094762.title: Development and Validation of a Nomogram Model to Predict the Risk of Severe Pneumonia in Children with Pneumococcal Infection
pmc-13094762.creator: Duoduo Li, Xixia Guo, Xiaolu Zhao, Li Wang, Xinyan Jia, Lingchao Wang, Weihong Lu, Xiangtao Wu, Fenglian Zhu
pmc-13094762.description: BackgroundStreptococcus pneumoniae is a leading cause of bacterial pneumonia in children, with severe cases rapidly progressing to respiratory failure and multiple organ dysfunction. Accurate early risk stratification tools are urgently needed. This study aimed to develop and validate a nomogram model to predict the risk of PICU admission in children with pneumococcal pneumonia.

pmc-13195902.title: Who deserves credit, who receives credit? A cross-sectional survey on the handling of co-authorship in medical dissertations in Germany
pmc-13195902.creator: Laura Klempp, Nadin Zerin Tanriverdi, Adrian Loerbroks, Niklas Juth, Nils Hansson
pmc-13195902.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThis study investigates the awareness and application of the internationally recognized Vancouver guidelines on co-authorship among doctoral students in medicine across North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW), Germany, the federal state with the highest number of medical faculties (nine) nationwide.

pmc-13366061.title: Ten tips to preserve and reuse water in nephrology
pmc-13366061.creator: Susi Knöller, Catherine Weber, Mohamed Ben Hmida, Rui Lucena, Faissal Tarrass, Stephan Segerer

pmc-13385930.title: Evaluating real-world deployment of an HL7-CDA-aligned LLM for ICD-10-CM coding
pmc-13385930.creator: Hong-Jie Dai, Zheng-Hao Li, An-Tai Lu, Min-I Su, Bo-Tsz Shain, Ming-Ta Li, Li-Li Wang, Kuang-Te Wang, Pei-Kang Liu, Vu Thinh Doan, Ming-Ju Tsai
pmc-13385930.description: Reliable ICD-10-CM coding remains a major operational burden in hospitals, and the real-world performance of AI systems for this task is poorly understood. We developed and deployed a modular, clinically grounded pipeline that combines principled base-model selection, redundancy-aware training, and HL7-aligned section prompts to support scalable ICD-10-CM coding across heterogeneous documentation environments.

pmc-13524256.title: Centers and peripheries: Spatial analysis of social inequalities in health in Antioquia, 2017–2023
pmc-13524256.creator: Gino Montenegro-Martínez
pmc-13524256.description: This study aims to analyze the performance and geographical distribution of health indicators in relation to social indicators in the municipalities of Antioquia. An ecological cross-sectional study was conducted using data on health outcomes, social indicators, and institutional capacity of the municipalities of the department for the period 2017–2023.
